purpose: Test whether recent pitch changes improve next-30-day whiffs-per-swing forecasts, overall and for the changed pitch type itself. Swing-and-miss responds to pitch quality faster and with less noise than K% and BB%.
definitions: Swings and whiffs use the study's existing Statcast description sets (pcf.dataset.SWINGS, WHIFFS). Whiffs per swing over the forecast date through 29 days later, regular season only.

targets.overall: Pitcher's whiffs / swings on all pitches in the next 30 days.
targets.per_type: Pitcher's whiffs / swings on one pitch type in the next 30 days.

overall_models: Same A, B, V, C, P and boosted NB/NP as forecast_value_v1, refit on the whiff target. The A results history already includes recent, season-to-date and prior-season whiff rates.
per_type_unit: One pitcher, forecast date and known pitch type thrown in both windows with at least two outings each (the review-list support floor). Scored when the next 30 days contain at least one swing on that type.

per_type_models.Bt: Pitcher-level B features plus the type's group (fastball, cutter, breaking, offspeed), its recent velocity, vertical and arm-side movement, recent usage, and the type's own shrunk whiff rate over the last 30 days, season to date, and prior season, with log swing counts.
per_type_models.Pt: Bt plus the type's shrunk velocity, vertical and arm-side movement changes, each interacted with the four pitch groups, plus its usage change and its prior-scaled change score.
per_type_models.NBt/NPt: Gradient-boosted trees on Bt and Pt features, so interactions are learned rather than declared.

type_whiff_shrinkage: (whiffs + 50 x league whiff rate) / (swings + 50), league rate from training seasons.
shrinkage: Physical-change priors as in forecast_value_v1: zero-centered, fitted on each fold's training seasons only.
tuning: Linear C from [0.001, 0.003, 0.01, 0.03, 0.1, 0.3, 1.0]; boosted max_iter from [100, 200, 400] with the fixed forecast_value_v1 tree settings; chosen on the inner validation season, then refit.
scoring: Binomial log loss per swing; pitcher-cluster bootstrap with 1000 draws; swing-weighted directional share.
subgroups: Exploratory per-type results by pitch group, and for rows whose prior-scaled change score is at least 2 (large measured changes).
evaluation: After development, freeze sources and settings (each model's 2024-fold choice), then score 2025 (train 2021-2024) and 2026 (train 2021-2025) once. Their K% results were already inspected and strikeouts correlate with whiffs, so these seasons are not fully untouched; report that limit.
stop_rule: Run development once, freeze, score the evaluation seasons once. Report every comparison regardless of direction; no feature or tuning changes after results.
